Our slim cut jeans, made from 16oz slubby selvedge denim. The most heavily textured denim in the Iron Heart lineup, our 16oz slubby selvedge is woven slowly and loosely (think off-the-scale loom-chatter!), resulting in a more irregular twill and an uneven fabric hand on both the face and reverse. Compared to other heavyweight weaves, this is a softer, more breathable denim which brims with distinctive character.   To create this darkened variation, we take a pair of standard IH-555S-SLB jeans and steep the entire garment in black dye using a direct dyeing process. This stains the indigo denim and stitching, with the added bonus of removing all shrinkage from the fabric. A unique middle ground between our traditional indigo and black denims, over time the fabric will gradually fade with blue-tinged hues in high-wear areas.

Our slim straight cut jeans, made from 19oz left-hand twill selvedge denim. While most of our denim features a traditional right-hand twill weave — characterised by a diagonal grain running from the top-right to the bottom-left of the fabric — this “lefty” denim is woven in the opposite direction under very high tension. This creates one of our stiffest, most robust fabrics, with an intense indigo hue that tends to fade with higher contrast than looser weaves.
To create this darkened variation, we take a pair of standard IH-666S-19L jeans and steep the entire garment in black dye using a direct dyeing process. This stains the indigo denim and stitching, with the added bonus of removing all shrinkage from the fabric. A unique middle ground between our traditional indigo and black denims, over time the fabric will gradually fade with blue-tinged hues in high-wear areas.
